rounding_policy: Prose figures may be rounded for readability if the stated figure is within 5% (relative) of the true value, or within 0.5 percentage points when the value is itself a percentage, AND the rounding does not change the sign, the direction of a change, a ranking, or which side of a stated threshold the value falls on. Words like 'about'/'roughly' are welcome but not required inside that band. A figure outside the band, or one that changes sign/direction/ranking, is a misstatement. Structured numeric output (the JSON) is NOT covered by this policy: it must meet each check's explicit tolerance.

rules.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.

commentary:
All data-quality checks pass (section 8). No parse warnings, and Jun 2026 is not flagged as a partial month.

- **Revenue:** 195,898 in Jun 2026. That is -6.0% vs May 2026 (208,351), -0.5% vs the prior 6-month average (196,946) and +2.8% vs Jun 2025 (190,556). May 2026 was the highest month in the export, so the month-over-month decline is measured from a peak. Usage Fees, 77.7% of TTM revenue, were 166,782 (-6.3% MoM, +12.6% YoY).
- **Revenue streams at zero:** Professional Services (833 in May 2026) and Partnership Income (477 in May 2026) are both zero in Jun 2026. SKU Profiling has been zero since May 2026 (last non-zero Apr 2026, 10,000). Whether each of these has ended or is timing is for the reviewer to confirm.
- **Gross margin:** 70.2% in Jun 2026, up from 67.0% in May 2026 (+3.1 pp) and equal to the prior 6-month average of 70.2%. It is 4.2 pp lower than Jun 2025 (74.3%).
- **Operating expenses:** 468,182 as exported (-2.2% vs May 2026). The largest category move is Finance & Admin, which went from 15,243 to -993. This comes mainly from Bad Debts, at -1,806 in Jun 2026 vs 12,935 in May 2026. At account level, Events & Conferences rose 17,971 to 29,295, and Partnerships Commission fell 9,000 to 1,800.
- **Expense lines at zero:** Federal & State Taxes (6-month average 999) and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous (6-month average 721) are zero in Jun 2026. Advisory Services has been zero since Feb 2026 (last non-zero Jan 2026, 2,500). The Professional Fees account has been zero since Apr 2026 (last non-zero Mar 2026, 3,773). Whether any of these has stopped for good or is timing is for the reviewer to confirm.
- **Net income:** -330,756 in Jun 2026, the 6th negative month in a row. TTM net income is -3,089,780. The only positive month in the export, Dec 2025 (534,551), is positive only because of non-operating items. Without them it is -715,902, and the largest of those items is Income Tax Benefit at -1,244,430.
- **Cash:** Cash and Cash Equivalents were 713,481 at Jun 2026. That is -215,543 vs May 2026 and -1,871,836 vs six months earlier (2,585,317).
- **Possible one-offs:** Stock-Based Compensation Expense (334,661) and Bonus (80,343) in Dec 2025 each appear to be a single-month item; the reviewer should confirm. Both are well above their typical months (0 and 2,721).
